text: MSF reports more than 700 war-wounded have overwhelmed hospitals in Tigray as fighting escalates. DW, citing observers, reports 'no regard for civilians'. Tigray has been under a communications blackout since Sep 25 per earlier reporting (day four on Sep 28).

judge.comment: Sourced to MSF and DW from tracker events; blackout start date is inferred from 'fourth day' on Sep 28, so a human should confirm before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Tigray blackout in fourth day on Sep 28

factChecks.source: Derived by counting back from 'fourth day' on Sep 28; not stated directly

text: How many Yemeni government troops died in the Aug 6 Marib/Hadramout offensive? The government confirmed at least 30 killed, 50 wounded. An unnamed military source told AFP the toll may have reached 58. The Houthis claim 45. Three sources, three counts.

judge.comment: Contested type never auto-approves. Both sides attributed with as-of date; no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: Government confirmed at least 30 killed and 50 wounded (Aug 6)
Unnamed military source told AFP toll may have reached 58

text: Who died in the Aug 10 drone strike on Merewa Secondary School? Tigrayan military sources: three of their fighters killed, seven hospitalized. Raya Alamata District Governor Daniel Tamrat: one civilian killed, four wounded. Same strike, two different casualty profiles.

judge.comment: Contested type never auto-approves. Both accounts attributed with the strike date; no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: Tigrayan military sources: three fighters died instantly, seven hospitalized
District governor Daniel Tamrat: one civilian killed, four wounded

text: Hormuz, Sep 29: crude exports reported at ~80% of pre-crisis levels; Sep 28 reporting put Persian Gulf exports at 72% of prewar. CENTCOM says over 1B barrels have transited under US passage-protection. Brent closed $104.32 on Sep 25. Saudi loadings remain -70% vs Jan-Feb.

judge.comment: Figures come from different event dates and scopes (Hormuz crude vs Persian Gulf exports) and the Saudi KPI has no stated as-of date; human check advised.

factChecks.claim: Persian Gulf oil exports 72% of prewar (Sep 28)

factChecks.source: hormuz-food-security-crisis KPI; as-of date not stated
